m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Whew. That was a close one. Thanks for rescuing me.
Zolo Stoneheart told me he knew where to find a priceless emerald treasure, called El Yollotl. With it I could start a new life!
But Zolo just wanted to make me write a novel starring him as the hero! As if!
Now that you've freed me, I'll just have to redouble my efforts to find that gemstone! Maybe we'll meet again!
Hello, Outsider. Your reputation precedes you as a great champion to many. Could you help find a Marleybonian visitor for me?
Her name is Kathleen Wilder and she is a writer of romantic stories. Like you, she is an outsider to Azteca.
She also likes to get into trouble. Lots of trouble. Last I saw her, she was obsessed with the legendary treasure, El Yollotl.
She said she had found and copied a rare treasure map, but that was the last I heard! No one has seen her since.
Kathleen Wilder has a small Ground Nest she was staying in. Can you search it for clues, and help me find her whereabouts?
Look in Kathleen Wilder's Ground Nest and see if you can find some clues to where she might be!
